statement: An archive operation archives each affected child with no surviving parent.

The archive operation uses this condition for each record below the archived record. It counts only the parents that are not archived at the end of the operation. An archive operation does not stop because a child has no other parent. An archived record cannot change to a different status, and it has an archive commit and an archive time. This Requirement replaced the error for a child with only one parent. A child that the operation archives keeps its parent fields. The operation removes the references to the archived parents only from a child that it does not archive.
